proposal.original_claim_summary: Trump Calls Immigrants 'Animals' at California Roundtable
proposal.original_synopsis: At a May 16, 2018 White House roundtable on sanctuary cities, as a Fresno County sheriff described the difficulty of removing gang members, Trump responded by saying 'We have people coming into the country — or trying to come in — and we're stopping a lot of them, but we're taking people out of the country. You wouldn't believe how bad these people are. These aren't people. These are animals.' While the White House initially claimed Trump was referring specifically to MS-13, the full transcript and context showed the comment was made broadly about immigrants. Using the word 'animals' to describe human beings echoes historical dehumanization rhetoric used to justify atrocities and was condemned by human rights organizations worldwide.
